baseline_prompt_en: A rental-listing photograph shows an entrance after cleaning is finished. The tiled floor is already clean, and a broom and dustpan stand resting beside the wall. The tools are parked at the edge of the entrance, leaving the clean walking space clearly visible. Daylight enters through the doorway and spreads softly across the neutral tiles, revealing their joints and modest surface sheen. A view through the threshold connects the foreground floor to the inner wall and door opening, giving an honest sense of the entrance's usable depth. Straight vertical lines and a calm, open composition suit a practical property listing. The resting tools and settled, empty space convey a completed chore and a room ready to use.
